name: Effects
description: Small light, finish, framing and detail effects that stack on any look.
author: PromptStyler Next contributors

styles.name: Tracking Tear
styles.description: Localized horizontal tracking disturbance while keeping the main subject legible.

clauses.text: short tape-tracking tear at the edge

styles.name: Contour cadence
styles.description: Line thickness changes deliberately along supplied silhouettes.

styles.name: Two-zone shadow cel
styles.description: Two broad shadow groups simplify illumination while retaining form.

clauses.text: one light group, one shadow group

styles.name: Colored shadow-side line
styles.description: Contour hue changes only inside existing shadow regions.

styles.name: Dry graphite cleanup
styles.description: Dry, broken drawing edges retain controlled construction.

styles.name: Paint-edge drift
styles.description: Slightly imperfect fill registration creates a handmade cel surface.

styles.name: Optical composite bloom
styles.description: Bright cel regions meet a soft optical compositing fringe.

clauses.text: soft bloom where light meets dark

styles.name: Background paint economy
styles.description: Secondary depth receives broader marks than the supplied focal content.

styles.name: Ink-trap junctions
styles.description: Line junctions open slightly instead of forming clogged dark knots.

styles.name: Peripheral Speed Lines
styles.description: Motion lines pushed toward the margins to preserve the subject.

clauses.text: sparse radiating ink motion lines at the edges

styles.name: Animation Hold
styles.description: Slightly imperfect held-animation-frame character without full film aging.

styles.name: Registration Crop
styles.description: Decorative print-shop registration fragments away from requested lettering.

clauses.text: sparse printer registration marks at the margins

styles.name: Hard Rule
styles.description: Heavy editorial rule lines used to stabilize an otherwise chaotic composition.

clauses.text: one or two thick divider rules

styles.name: Gentle Background Bokeh
styles.description: Sparing peripheral softness that preserves the requested subject and text.

styles.name: Soft Film Grain
styles.description: Barely perceptible organic grain for warm everyday memories.

styles.name: Dream Discontinuity
styles.description: Subtle spatial mismatch while retaining recognizable subject identity.

styles.name: Memory Bleed
styles.description: Peripheral doubling reminiscent of overlapping recollections.

styles.name: Ragged Crop Marks
styles.description: Asymmetric cut-paper edges suitable for adding typesetting later.

styles.name: Risograph Registration
styles.description: Small-scale spot-color plate misalignment without corrupting requested text.

styles.name: Intentional Pixel Edges
styles.description: Pixelation confined to existing edges while preserving overall scene content.

styles.name: HUD-Safe Framing
styles.description: A generous peripheral margin suitable for adding interface widgets later.

styles.name: Cursor-Trail Accent
styles.description: A delicate digital movement effect integrated around existing points of interaction.

styles.name: Sticker Chaos
styles.description: Collaged sticker edges and playful graphic layering.

styles.name: Repetitive Geometry
styles.description: Increases architectural rhythm without introducing a specific building type.

styles.name: Off-Hour Stillness
styles.description: A restrained emotional treatment emphasizing pauses and absence.

styles.name: Broad softbox
styles.description: Illuminate the supplied subject with a broad soft source. Let the shadow side remain gentle while retaining dimensional modeling.

styles.name: Raking light
styles.description: Let a low raking light describe the existing surface relief. Use long shallow shadows to reveal tactile structure.

styles.name: Overcast diffusion
styles.description: Use diffuse overcast illumination. Keep color neutral and shadow boundaries broad and soft.

styles.name: Restrained rim light
styles.description: Use a narrow rim of light to separate the existing outer contour. Keep the rim localized rather than outlining every surface.

clauses.text: narrow rim light on outer edges

styles.name: Split illumination
styles.description: Divide the principal form between a lit side and a clear shadow side. Keep the lighting boundary purposeful and the shadow detail readable.

clauses.text: split lighting, half lit and half shadow
clear shadow side with visible detail

styles.name: Warm bounced light
styles.description: Let warm reflected light gently fill the shadow side. Preserve the direction of the main light source.

styles.name: Deliberate negative space
styles.description: Give the supplied subject deliberate breathing room. Keep large quiet areas subordinate to the original focus.

clauses.text: small focal subject in open space

styles.name: Measured symmetry
styles.description: Arrange the supplied forms around a balanced central axis. Keep bilateral visual weight measured without duplicating the subject.

styles.name: Diagonal rhythm
styles.description: Emphasize diagonal relationships already present in the forms. Use the diagonal flow to lead attention toward the main focus.

styles.name: Layered depth
styles.description: Separate the existing foreground, middle distance and background. Use overlap and value differences to maintain a clear depth read.

styles.name: Close crop
styles.description: Use a close crop around the supplied focal subject. Let peripheral details fall outside the frame while retaining the intended action.

styles.name: Frontal clarity
styles.description: Use a direct frontal presentation of the supplied forms. Keep horizontal and vertical relationships deliberate and easy to read.

styles.name: Uncoated paper
styles.description: Give the image a restrained uncoated-paper surface. Keep visible fine fibers without obscuring small important details.

styles.name: Fine organic grain
styles.description: Add fine organic grain to the image texture. Let the grain vary gently with tone rather than forming a uniform overlay.

styles.name: Restrained halation
styles.description: Allow a restrained glow around the brightest existing highlights. Keep dark edges and the main subject clearly defined.

styles.name: Dry-brush edge
styles.description: Let selected painted edges break into dry-brush marks. Keep larger masses coherent while exposing the underlying surface.

styles.name: Directional hatching
styles.description: Use directional hatching to describe existing volume. Follow the curvature of the forms with changes in line density.

styles.name: Pigment granulation
styles.description: Let visible pigment granulation enrich painted tonal areas. Concentrate granules in pooled color rather than every bright region.

styles.name: Hushed restraint
styles.description: Keep the visual mood hushed and restrained. Favor gentle transitions and unhurried relationships between forms.

styles.name: Held tension
styles.description: Give the supplied scene a sense of held visual tension. Keep relationships slightly unresolved without introducing new story elements.

clauses.text: hard side light with tense shadows

styles.name: Open celebration
styles.description: Give the supplied scene an open celebratory visual mood. Use lively visual rhythm while retaining the original content.

styles.name: Selective focal detail
styles.description: Concentrate small descriptive detail at the existing focus. Let secondary forms remain deliberately simpler.

clauses.text: fine detail on the focal subject only

styles.name: Economy of marks
styles.description: Describe the supplied forms with an economical number of marks. Remove redundant small detail while preserving identifying structure.

styles.name: Tactile observation
styles.description: Emphasize the material qualities of the existing surfaces. Let small wear, weave or grain details follow the supplied materials.

styles.name: Fine Compass Lines
styles.description: Decorative circular construction lines that do not overwhelm the subject.

styles.name: Paper Gilt Edges
styles.description: A subtle raised gilding treatment along selected graphic borders.

styles.name: Stress-color interference
styles.description: Localized interference bands follow existing translucent forms.

clauses.text: rainbow interference colors in clear materials

styles.name: Dichroic edge shift
styles.description: A thin-film hue split is confined to oblique highlights.

styles.name: Index-matched quiet
styles.description: Low-contrast internal boundaries retain the supplied outer silhouette.

styles.name: Retroreflective return
styles.description: A compact near-view highlight reads as light returning toward the observer.

styles.name: Subsurface edge transmission
styles.description: Thin existing edges carry soft transmitted illumination.

styles.name: Frosted rim scatter
styles.description: Roughened edge highlights soften without an overall image blur.

styles.name: Fluorescent surface spill
styles.description: Small emissive-looking regions lift adjacent tones with controlled falloff.

styles.name: Anisotropic highlight streak
styles.description: Long highlights follow one supplied material direction.

styles.name: Tape Edge Wear
styles.description: Modest frame-edge tape damage that leaves focal information intact.

clauses.text: short tape disturbances at outer margins

styles.name: Off-Axis Repeat
styles.description: A single spatial echo that disturbs geometry without replacing the primary subject.

clauses.text: one framing line echoed at a near angle

styles.name: Peripheral Awareness
styles.description: Soft visual tension held at the margins of a scene.

styles.name: Long Metaphysical Shadow
styles.description: Elongated geometrically readable shadows for allegorical atmospheres.

styles.name: Symbolic Pause
styles.description: Calm emotional suspension conveyed by negative space and measured detail.

styles.name: Filament Highlights
styles.description: Hairline luminous contour traces around existing forms.

clauses.text: a few thin luminous contour filaments

styles.name: Radial Breath
styles.description: Subtle expansion and contraction rhythm built from nested negative space.

styles.name: Intentional JPEG Damage
styles.description: Low-quality digital compression as a deliberate material treatment.

clauses.text: visible JPEG blocks and mosquito noise
